<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="nihils" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Nihils</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The quest Fate of the Gods is a requirement to fight Nihils or get them as a slayer task. Despite being a Nihil, Nex </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513213159071547395.png?v=1" alt="Nex" title="Nex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not affected by being on a task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As Nihils are not technically demons, the various demon slayer buffs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502842653900818.png?v=1" alt="demonslayerperk" title="demonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921675845633.png?v=1" alt="demonslayer" title="demonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> do not work on them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They are permanently aggressive unless the player is wielding a Shard of Zaros and run at the same speed as the player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each nihil variant has their own unique special they will use after a few autos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Smoke nihil: Reduces combat stats.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This effect is easily nullified by overloads.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shadow nihil: Deals 500 typeless damage 3 times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blood nihil: Stops attacking, becomes invulnerable to styled damage and absorbs incoming damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Blood Nihils will not heal from damage in a player-owned dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Poison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will still damage them normally.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ice nihil: Drains 50 prayer points per attack. Also stuns and binds the player </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1102897815073603685.png?v=1" alt="bindicon" title="bindicon" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These rates are calculated with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>blood Nihils</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 2,532.6 + 835.7 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 705.4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~790 (AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour : ~557K (AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Summoning ingredient drops (Aviansie talons, Demon horn, Vampyre fangs, Icyene feather)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped from the Smoke, Shadow, Blood and Ice Nihils respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used to craft Nihil familiar pouches </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1" alt="smokenihil" title="smokenihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1" alt="shadownihil" title="shadownihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1" alt="bloodnihil" title="bloodnihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442164334592.png?v=1" alt="icenihil" title="icenihil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They also have a very small chance to drop the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791280228377952276.png?v=1" alt="zarytebow" title="zarytebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, though one has a much better chance of obtaining this drop by killing Nex.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-items"><nowiki>Useful Items</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Shard_of_Zaros <strong><nowiki>Shard of Zaros</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki>
    • Removes nihil aggression.
    • This is absolutely essential if gathering souls or killing them individually.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sixth-Age_circuit <strong><nowiki>Sixth-Age Circuit</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1" alt="sixthagecircuit" title="sixthagecircuit" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Allows for an easy teleport to the World Gate.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Grace_of_the_elves <strong><nowiki>Grace of the Elves</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900765150678749204.png?v=1" alt="gote" title="gote" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Highly useful as a swap to automatically bank nihil materials.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Teleport to the World Gate with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1" alt="sixthagecircuit" title="sixthagecircuit" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, set it to Freneskae and select the option &quot;The Pit&quot; to teleport to where Nihils are. Walking on the center tile will provide the option to spawn Nihils for slayer.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alternatively, teleport to Eagles' Peak lodestone </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552307595948052.png?v=1" alt="eaglespeaklode" title="eaglespeaklode" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and run south to the World Gate.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-low-effort-magic"><ins><nowiki>Method: Low effort Magic</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Magic can utilise the terrain and Nihils' natural aggression to group them up, followed by barraging them down with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The use of tank armour and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> also helps it withstand the attacks of multiple Nihils.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="preset"><nowiki>Preset</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0BUcOGXcnqpjDNocpL0Z <nowiki>Low effort Magic</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0BUcOGXcnqpjDNocpL0Z.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy"><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Spawn the Nihils and run around the pillars to group them up. Make sure to have less than 9 on you else </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will not hit all of them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If done properly, this achieves ~500kph, getting around 70-100 Nihil pouch ingredients + ~5m in other commons (mostly from onyx bolts and herbs). Being on task helps but the short length of Nihil slayer tasks makes this method mostly impractical for XP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-magic-posd"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Magic [PoSD]</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>As players can place specific nihil variants in a dungeon, the best method of killing Nihils is AoEing </nowiki><strong><nowiki>blood Nihils</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in the player owned dungeon. This can be done with both revo++ or legacy.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Revo++ vs Legacy:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Legacy benefits: Tank armour not required.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Revo++ benefits: Significantly lower rune cost and higher kph (~120 more with a BIS setup).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If using legacy with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1" alt="inquisitorstaff" title="inquisitorstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289714098246.png?v=1" alt="bloodburst" title="bloodburst" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, otherwise, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Cast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if using revo++</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="presets"><nowiki>Presets</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=caAj2jaWsxNWFUEWn8md <nowiki>Active Magic (Soul Gathering)</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/b2b7ff7f64f1d08cd48f3a3239994f62672f76102b71d67f34c19beaec024536.webp" alt="Nihils (Active Magic) [Soul Gathering]" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=q7fGOb0BeX1VgOsu5JPB <nowiki>AFK Magic (PoSD)</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fq7fGOb0BeX1VgOsu5JPB.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy-gathering-souls"><nowiki>Strategy - Gathering souls</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As blood Nihils cannot be isolated from the other nihil variants, they must be fought in an active manner. Magic is suggested for this although it may also be viable to use ranged with sufficient accuracy boosts.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do NOT have multi-hitting abilities on your bar to avoid aggroing other Nihils. This includes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809995874304.png?v=1" alt="tsunami" title="tsunami" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1" alt="corruptblast" title="corruptblast" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used as it does not aggro other Nihils.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee is not as viable as you will spend a lot of time chasing Nihils around due to their high mobility.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stand in the western area of The Pit where the blood Nihils spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Do not spend excessive amounts of time chasing the nihil. Target close-by Nihils as fast as possible after they spawn to prevent them from running away.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy-posd-slaying"><nowiki>Strategy - PoSD slaying</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Place the Nihils in the small room. Stand in the middle of the room if using revo++.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stand in the northeast corner (yellow box) if using legacy.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/dONoLgJiU7.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="revo-bar"><nowiki>Revo bar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/HwPgJ9wsim.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
